description: Agent Cybersecurity: submit a standing-access record with its least-privilege policy: the policy with the days between privileged access reviews, the days unused after which access counts as dormant, the days allowed to complete a revocation, whether privileged access and keys must carry an expiry, and its text; each account or key with its id, holder, kind (a person, a service, an agent, a key or a shared account), the system, its named owner and whether that owner is still active, the access granted and the access the work requires (none, read, write, admin or owner), and the days it was last used, last reviewed and expires and had its revocation requested and completed; and optionally the day the record is read on. The signed report gives every account with its kind, level, need and status, the accounts at their needed level, the dormant accounts, the orphaned and shared accounts, the privileged accounts with their reviews, and the open revocations, uses after revocation or expiry and missing expiries, and counts them, and names overbroad access: access the work does not require, admin or owner access above the need, standing access with no current owner, access used after it was revoked or expired, and a revocation open past the days the policy allows; then write access where the work reads, access unused past the dormant period, privileged access past its review cycle, access active past its expiry, privileged access or keys with no expiry where the policy requires one, and shared accounts, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No accounts, an active account with no level granted or needed, no dormant period, no day read on, no last use, an unknown owner status or no review cycle for privileged access leaves the access unverified. This reads a standing-access review across every account and key: wever_onboarding-permissions-check reads one new agent’s grants against its written job at joining, wever_onboarding-access-check reads whether a new agent’s system access was set up and tested before its first task, and wever_observability-access-check reads who may see an agent’s traces and logs. Verdict cyber_access_overbroad, cyber_access_partial, cyber_access_unverified or cyber_access_scoped. POST /api/cyber-access-check. Reads the security records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, system scan, probe or external write. Agent Cybersecurity reads an organization’s own security records after the fact and checks them against the stated policy and against themselves: standing access, the secrets inventory, the component and patch record, the exported configuration, logging coverage, backup and restore evidence, a vendor’s security evidence and incident readiness. Beside it, the Agent Risk checks such as wever_risk-exposure-check read one planned action’s worst case and limits before it runs, while a cyber check reads security posture from the records; and the security reads elsewhere in the catalog keep their families, each named beside the check it meets. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-cybersecurity-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-cybersecurity/.

accounts.description: Each account or key with standing access.

needed.description: The access the work requires, as recorded.

owner_status.description: Whether the named owner is still active, as recorded.

as_of.description: The day the records are read on, such as 2026-11-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

dormant_days.description: Days unused after which access counts as dormant.

expiry_required.description: Whether privileged access and keys must carry an expiry.

review_days.description: Days between reviews of privileged access.

revoke_days.description: Days allowed to complete a revocation.

name: wever_cyber-access-check
title: Cyber access check
